Definition: Chanani, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hanani is a name carried by six Israelites, and the sharpest of them is the father of the prophet Jehu. The word of the LORD came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet Jehoshaphat and rebuke him, and another Hanani, a son of Heman, is counted among the musicians of the temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hanani's line shows both sides of God's house: a father who raised a prophet, and a son who sang in the temple. The prophet's rebuke and the musician's song both belong to the same family of service.
RelatedPeople: Hanani, Father of Jehu the Prophet; Jehu, Son of Hanani
